title: Release review: a corrected date and a security condition

people.name: Asha
people.description: An adult woman with a warm medium-low voice and a natural Indian English accent. Clear conversational speech.

people.name: Daniel
people.description: An adult man with a light British English accent, medium pitch and a slightly dry vocal texture. Relaxed conversational speech.

people.name: Maya
people.description: An adult woman with a crisp medium-high voice and an Indian English accent. Precise, steady conversational speech.

people.name: Vikram
people.description: An adult man with a natural Delhi Hindi accent, medium-low pitch and a lightly breathy voice. Comfortable switching between Hindi and English.

facts.statement: Target release is Tuesday 23 June, conditional on security approval; Monday is not confirmed.
The test-device budget ceiling is 800 euros, not 1800 euros.
Skipping the security review was rejected.
Daniel will fix the token refresh bug by Thursday 18 June at noon.
Maya will finish the security review by Friday 19 June at 15:00.
Vikram will send customers the confirmed plan by Friday 19 June at 17:00.
The mobile Safari login issue still needs an owner and is not resolved.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Before we start, I want to settle the release date, the security review, and what we tell customers. Please correct me if I have an old date.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.text: ग्राहक सोमवार की उम्मीद कर रहे हैं। हमने पिछले हफ़्ते कहा था कि सोमवार को तैयार हो जाएगा। अब मैं उन्हें क्या बताऊँ?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: The desktop build is ready, but the token refresh bug is still open. I would not promise Monday while that can log people out in the middle of a call.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Daniel, can you own that fix? I need an actual deadline, not just this week.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Yes. I will fix token refresh by noon on Thursday, the eighteenth of June. Maya can review that build after lunch.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.text: After lunch is fine for starting. It is not a promise that the entire review will be done on Thursday.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.text: लेकिन अगर review में इतना समय लगा, तो क्या हम इसे बाद में कर सकते हैं? Customers are already angry.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.text: No. We are not skipping security approval. An angry customer is a problem; exposing their meeting recordings would be a much bigger problem.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Agreed. Security review stays a release condition. Vikram, I understand the pressure, but please do not offer Monday as a confirmed date.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.text: ठीक है। मैं सोमवार का वादा नहीं करूँगा। बस मुझे शुक्रवार तक एक साफ़ जवाब चाहिए।

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: There is one cost question. I wrote eighteen hundred euros for the test devices in the draft. That includes buying two extra phones.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: That figure is too high. We can borrow the phones. Eight hundred euros is the ceiling, including delivery. Please correct the draft.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Right, eight hundred, not eighteen hundred. I had missed the loan arrangement. I will update the draft after this call.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Maya, assuming Daniel hands over the fix on Thursday at noon, when can you give the final security decision?

turns.speaker: S3
turns.text: Friday the nineteenth, by three in the afternoon. If I find a critical issue, I will report it sooner. Approval is not automatic just because we reached the deadline.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Thanks. I have Maya owning the review, Friday at fifteen hundred. We will make the customer announcement after that decision.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.text: मैं Friday, उन्नीस जून को शाम पाँच बजे तक customers को confirmed plan भेज दूँगा। Maya की approval से पहले कोई announcement नहीं जाएगी।

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes, Vikram sends the confirmed plan by five on Friday. If approval is missing, the message explains the delay instead of promising a release.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Then should the new target be Tuesday, the twenty-third? That gives us Monday for the final packaging checks.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Tuesday the twenty-third is our target, conditional on security approval. Monday is packaging day, not release day. Let us keep that distinction clear.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.text: One last thing: mobile Safari login still has no owner. I am not claiming that issue is fixed, and it is separate from Daniel's token refresh work.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Leave Safari login under open issues with no owner for now. I will bring the staffing question to tomorrow's triage. Those are the decisions for this call.
